```{r}
# --- Define Patients to Remove ---
# Add the Subject/Patient IDs of any individuals with unreliable data to this list.
patients_to_remove <- c(
  # "SUBJECT_ID_TO_REMOVE_1", # Example: "ABCD123"
  # "SUBJECT_ID_TO_REMOVE_2"  # Add more IDs as needed
)

# --- Filter Main Dataframes ---
# This removes the specified subjects from all primary data sources at the start.
if (length(patients_to_remove) > 0 && !all(startsWith(patients_to_remove, "SUBJECT_ID"))) {
    if (exists("Stat")) {
      Stat <- Stat %>% filter(!Patient %in% patients_to_remove)
    }
    if (exists("SleepAnalysis")) {
      SleepAnalysis <- SleepAnalysis %>% filter(!Subject %in% patients_to_remove)
    }
    if (exists("CorsanoAnalysismulti")) {
      CorsanoAnalysismulti <- CorsanoAnalysismulti %>% filter(!Subject %in% patients_to_remove)
    }
    if (exists("CorsanoAnalysissplit")) {
      CorsanoAnalysissplit <- CorsanoAnalysissplit %>% filter(!Subject %in% patients_to_remove)
    }
    if (exists("CorsanoAnalysisWave")) {
      CorsanoAnalysisWave <- CorsanoAnalysisWave %>% filter(!Subject %in% patients_to_remove)
    }
    cat("Removed", length(patients_to_remove), "subjects from the analysis.\n")
}


#**================================================================**
#** Part 1: Initial Sleep Data Processing                          **
#**================================================================**

# --- Prepare and Bin Sleep Data to Attach ---
Sleeptmp <- SleepAnalysis %>%
  mutate(Time_hrs = Time / 60) %>%
  mutate(Time_binned = round(Time_hrs * 6) / 6) %>%
  group_by(Time_binned, Subject) %>%
  summarise(SleepStages = round(mean(SleepStages, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = 'drop')

# --- Attach Sleep Data and Define Consistent Weekday/Weekend Status ---
CorsanoAnalysisSleepmulti <- CorsanoAnalysismulti %>%
  mutate(Time_binned = round(Time * 6) / 6) %>%
  left_join(Sleeptmp, by = c("Subject", "Time_binned")) %>%
  mutate(Time = Time_binned) %>%
  select(-Time_binned) %>%
  mutate(
    Sleep = ifelse(is.na(SleepStages), 0, 1),
    Time24 = Time %% 24,
    Week = case_when(
      Day == "Friday" & Time24 >= 18 ~ "Weekend",
      Day == "Sunday" & Time24 >= 18 ~ "Weekday",
      Day %in% c("Saturday", "Sunday") ~ "Weekend",
      TRUE ~ "Weekday"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Day)) %>%
  select(-Time24)


# --- Create the Master 1-Minute Timeline ---
# Function to identify the consolidated sleep period WITHIN a given session.
identify_consolidated_sleep <- function(df) {
  if (!any(df$SleepStages %in% c(1, 2, 3))) {
    return(df %>% mutate(in_sleep_period = FALSE))
  }
  sleep_blocks <- df %>%
    mutate(is_sleep = SleepStages %in% c(1, 2, 3),
           sleep_block_id = rleid(is_sleep)) %>%
    filter(is_sleep) %>%
    group_by(sleep_block_id) %>%
    filter(n() >= 20)
  if (nrow(sleep_blocks) == 0) {
    return(df %>% mutate(in_sleep_period = FALSE))
  }
  start_period <- min(sleep_blocks$Time, na.rm = TRUE)
  end_period <- df %>% 
    filter(SleepStages %in% c(1,2,3)) %>%
    summarise(max_time = max(Time, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
    pull(max_time)
  df %>%
    mutate(in_sleep_period = Time >= start_period & Time <= end_period)
}

# Create a base dataframe with all necessary columns
CorsanoAnalysisSleepexpand_base <- CorsanoAnalysisSleepmulti %>%
  group_by(Subject, Week) %>%
  reframe(Time = seq(min(Time, na.rm = TRUE), max(Time, na.rm = TRUE), by = 1/60)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(CorsanoAnalysisSleepmulti, by = c("Subject", "Week", "Time")) %>%
  mutate(Time_rounded = round(Time, 5)) %>%
  left_join(
    SleepAnalysis %>%
      mutate(Time_rounded = round(Time / 60, 5)) %>%
      select(-Time), 
    by = c("Subject", "Time_rounded")
  ) %>%
  mutate(Bed = if_else(!is.na(SleepStages.y), 1, 0)) %>%
  rename(SleepStages = SleepStages.y) %>%
  select(-SleepStages.x, -Time_rounded)
  
# NEW LOGIC: Correctly identifies sleep sessions based on an 8-hour gap in "Bed" time.
in_bed_blocks <- CorsanoAnalysisSleepexpand_base %>%
  filter(Bed == 1) %>%
  group_by(Subject) %>%
  mutate(block_id = cumsum(c(0, diff(Time)) > 1/60 + 0.001)) %>%
  group_by(Subject, block_id) %>%
  summarise(start_time = min(Time), end_time = max(Time), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  group_by(Subject) %>%
  mutate(gap_from_prev = start_time - lag(end_time, default = first(start_time) - 9)) %>%
  mutate(SleepSession = cumsum(gap_from_prev > 8)) %>%
  select(Subject, start_time, end_time, SleepSession)

# Map the correct SleepSession ID back to the main dataframe
CorsanoAnalysisSleepexpand <- CorsanoAnalysisSleepexpand_base %>%
  left_join(in_bed_blocks, by = "Subject") %>%
  filter(Time >= start_time & Time <= end_time) %>%
  group_by(Subject, SleepSession) %>%
  do(identify_consolidated_sleep(.)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    Sleep = if_else(in_sleep_period, SleepSession, 0),
    SleepStages = if_else(is.na(SleepStages), 4, SleepStages)
  ) %>%
  select(any_of(colnames(CorsanoAnalysisSleepexpand_base)), Sleep)


#**================================================================**
#** Part 2: Advanced Chronotype & Sleep Quality Analysis           **
#**================================================================**

#=============== Helper Functions ===============#
find_peak_phase <- function(data, column) {
  peaks <- findpeaks(data[[column]], minpeakheight = -Inf, minpeakdistance = 1, threshold = 0)
  if (is.null(peaks)) return(NA)
  highest_peak_index <- peaks[which.max(peaks[, 1]), 2]
  return(data$Time[highest_peak_index])
}
safe_which_min_time <- function(time_col, value_col) {
  valid_indices <- !is.na(value_col)
  if (!any(valid_indices)) return(NA_real_)
  return(time_col[valid_indices][which.min(value_col[valid_indices])])
}
safe_which_max_time <- function(time_col, value_col) {
  valid_indices <- !is.na(value_col)
  if (!any(valid_indices)) return(NA_real_)
  return(time_col[valid_indices][which.max(value_col[valid_indices])])
}

#=============== Main Analysis Function ===============#
# This single function now calculates all advanced metrics, including the new MP and SL.
process_all_metrics <- function(subject_sleep_expand, subject_split, subject_wave, week_type) {
  if (nrow(subject_sleep_expand) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  subjectid <- unique(subject_sleep_expand$Subject)
  Test1 <- subject_split
  Test2 <- subject_wave %>% filter(Time <= 24)

  #--- NEW MP & medianSL Calculation ---
  sleep_periods_info <- subject_sleep_expand %>%
    filter(Bed == 1) %>%
    group_by(Subject) %>%
    mutate(time_gap = c(0, diff(Time))) %>%
    mutate(period_id = cumsum(time_gap > 1/60 + 0.001)) %>%
    group_by(Subject, period_id) %>%
    summarise(start_time = min(Time), end_time = max(Time), .groups = 'drop') %>%
    group_by(Subject) %>%
    mutate(gap_from_prev = start_time - lag(end_time, default = first(start_time) - 9)) %>%
    mutate(unique_sleep_period_id = cumsum(gap_from_prev > 8)) %>%
    mutate(duration_hours = end_time - start_time) %>%
    filter(duration_hours >= 3 & duration_hours <= 12)

  if(nrow(sleep_periods_info) > 0) {
    period_metrics <- sleep_periods_info %>%
      mutate(data = map2(start_time, end_time, ~subject_sleep_expand %>% filter(Time >= .x, Time <= .y))) %>%
      mutate(
        Bed_start_time = start_time,
        Sleep_start_time = map_dbl(data, function(period_data) {
          sleep_onset_data <- period_data %>%
            filter(SleepStages %in% c(1, 2, 3) & lag(SleepStages, default = 4) == 4)
          if (nrow(sleep_onset_data) > 0) first(sleep_onset_data$Time) else NA_real_
        }),
        End_time = end_time,
        sleep_latency_minutes = if_else(!is.na(Sleep_start_time), (Sleep_start_time - Bed_start_time) * 60, NA_real_),
        adjusted_end_time = if_else(End_time < Sleep_start_time, End_time + 24, End_time),
        mp_continuous = if_else(!is.na(Sleep_start_time), (Sleep_start_time + adjusted_end_time) / 2, NA_real_),
        mp_24h = mp_continuous %% 24,
        mp_centered = if_else(mp_24h > 12, mp_24h - 24, mp_24h)
      )
    
    final_MP <- mean(period_metrics$mp_centered, na.rm = TRUE)
    valid_latencies <- period_metrics %>% filter(sleep_latency_minutes <= 60)
    final_medianSL <- median(valid_latencies$sleep_latency_minutes, na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    final_MP <- NA_real_
    final_medianSL <- NA_real_
  }

  #--- Other Core Sleep Metrics ---#
  sleep_time_epochs <- sum(subject_sleep_expand$Sleep != 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  bed_time_epochs <- sum(subject_sleep_expand$Bed == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  SE <- if (bed_time_epochs > 0) (sleep_time_epochs / bed_time_epochs) * 100 else 0
  total_sleep_hours <- sleep_time_epochs / 60
  sleep_lagged <- subject_sleep_expand %>% mutate(prev_stage = lag(SleepStages))
  trans1 <- sleep_lagged %>% filter((prev_stage %in% c(1, 3)) & (SleepStages %in% c(2, 4))) %>% nrow()
  FI1 <- if (total_sleep_hours > 0) trans1 / total_sleep_hours else 0
  trans2 <- sleep_lagged %>% filter(!is.na(prev_stage) & prev_stage != SleepStages) %>% nrow()
  FI2 <- if (total_sleep_hours > 0) trans2 / total_sleep_hours else 0
  
  #--- Chronotype: Physiological Nadirs ---#
  min_values <- cbind(
    summarise(Test1, minCBT=safe_which_min_time(Time,CBT), maxSBT=safe_which_max_time(Time,SBT), minHR=safe_which_min_time(Time,HR), minCor=safe_which_min_time(Time,Cortisol)),
    summarise(Test2, minBreath=safe_which_min_time(Time,BreathCosine), minHRV=safe_which_min_time(Time,HRVCosine))
  ) %>% mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(!is.na(.) & . > 12, . - 24, .)))
  all_mins <- unlist(min_values)
  midrange <- mean(c(median(all_mins, na.rm=TRUE), mean(all_mins, na.rm=TRUE)), na.rm=TRUE)
  MAD <- mean(abs(all_mins - midrange), na.rm = TRUE) * 60
  weights <- c(0.25, 0.2, 0.15, 0.2, 0.1, 0.1)
  WMAD <- sum(abs(all_mins - midrange) * weights, na.rm = TRUE) / 6 * 60
  
  #--- Chronotype: Lark vs. Owl ---#
  mid <- ifelse(!is.na(midrange) & midrange > 14, midrange - 24, midrange)
  Lark <- pmax(0, pmin(100, (-(mid - 2) / 8 + 0.5) * 100))
  
  #--- Chronotype: Energy/Activity Peak ---#
  PA <- find_peak_phase(Test2, "StepsCosine")
  TA_cos <- find_peak_phase(Test2 %>% mutate(StepsCosine = -StepsCosine), "StepsCosine")
  AEarly <- if (!is.na(PA) && !is.na(TA_cos)) pmax(0, pmin(100, (-(PA - (TA_cos+12)) / 8 + 0.5) * 100)) else NA

  #--- Rapid vs. Sluggish Wake Up ---#
  metrics <- c("CBTCosine", "HRCosine", "BreathCosine", "HRVCosine", "CortisolCosine", "StressCosine", "-SBTCosine", "-RRCosine")
  results_list <- lapply(metrics, function(metric) {
    metric_name <- sub("-", "", metric); y <- if(startsWith(metric,"-")) -Test2[[metric_name]] else Test2[[metric_name]]
    if(all(is.na(y))) return(NULL)
    x <- Test2$Time
    y_doubled <- c(y, y); x_doubled <- c(x, x + 24); min_index <- which.min(y)
    peaks <- tryCatch({findpeaks(y_doubled[min_index:(min_index + length(y))])}, error = function(e) {return(NULL)})
    if(is.null(peaks)) return(NULL)
    peak_index <- min_index + peaks[1, 2] - 1
    if (length(peak_index) == 0 || peak_index == min_index) return(NULL)
    slope_upward <- (y_doubled[peak_index] - y_doubled[min_index]) / (x_doubled[peak_index] - x_doubled[min_index])
    highest_peak_index <- which.max(y)
    troughs <- tryCatch({findpeaks(-y_doubled[highest_peak_index:(highest_peak_index + length(y))])}, error = function(e) {return(NULL)})
    if(is.null(troughs)) return(NULL)
    next_min_index <- highest_peak_index + troughs[1, 2] - 1
    if(length(next_min_index) == 0 || next_min_index == highest_peak_index) return(NULL)
    slope_downward <- -(y_doubled[next_min_index] - y_doubled[highest_peak_index]) / (x_doubled[next_min_index] - x_doubled[highest_peak_index])
    amplitude <- (max(y, na.rm=T) - min(y, na.rm=T)) / 2; mid_slope <- (max(y, na.rm=T) - min(y, na.rm=T)) / 12
    if(amplitude == 0) return(NULL)
    AAARapid <- pmax(0, pmin(100, (((slope_upward - mid_slope) / amplitude / 2 * 10) + 0.5) * 100))
    ABAFast <- pmax(0, pmin(100, (((slope_downward - mid_slope) / amplitude / 2 * 10) + 0.5) * 100))
    return(data.frame(AAARapid, ABAFast))
  })
  wake_sleep_metrics <- do.call(rbind, results_list)
  # === FIX STARTS HERE ===
  # Check if wake_sleep_metrics is NULL or empty before calculating mean
  if (!is.null(wake_sleep_metrics) && nrow(wake_sleep_metrics) > 0) {
    AAARapid_avg <- mean(wake_sleep_metrics$AAARapid, na.rm = TRUE)
    ABAFast_avg <- mean(wake_sleep_metrics$ABAFast, na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    # If no data found for any metric, assign NA
    AAARapid_avg <- NA_real_
    ABAFast_avg <- NA_real_
  }
  # === FIX ENDS HERE ===

  #--- Combine All Results ---#
  midrangeC <- if_else(!is.na(midrange) & midrange < 0, midrange + 24, midrange)
  
  return(data.frame(
    Patient = subjectid, Week = week_type, medianSL = final_medianSL, SE = SE, FI1 = FI1, FI2 = FI2, MP = final_MP,
    midrange = midrange, midrangeC = midrangeC, WMAD = WMAD, MAD = MAD, L = Lark, O = 100 - Lark, E = AEarly, D = 100 - AEarly,
    R = AAARapid_avg, S = 100 - AAARapid_avg, F = ABAFast_avg, I = 100 - ABAFast_avg
  ))
}

#=============== Execute the Analysis Loop ===============#

# --- Reclassify Week for Consistency ---
CorsanoAnalysissplit_reclassified <- CorsanoAnalysissplit %>%
  mutate(
    Time24 = Time %% 24,
    Week = case_when(
      Day == "Friday" & Time24 >= 18 ~ "Weekend",
      Day == "Sunday" & Time24 >= 18 ~ "Weekday",
      Day %in% c("Saturday", "Sunday") ~ "Weekend",
      TRUE ~ "Weekday"
    )
  ) %>% select(-Time24)

# --- Create Task List ---
analysis_groups <- bind_rows(
  distinct(CorsanoAnalysissplit_reclassified, Subject, Week) %>% filter(!is.na(Week)),
  distinct(CorsanoAnalysissplit_reclassified, Subject) %>% mutate(Week = "Both")
)

# --- Run Analysis Loop ---
all_subject_results <- lapply(1:nrow(analysis_groups), function(i) {
  current_subject <- analysis_groups$Subject[i]
  current_week <- analysis_groups$Week[i]
  cat("Processing Patient:", current_subject, "for Week:", current_week, "\n")
  
  subject_wave <- filter(CorsanoAnalysisWave, Subject == current_subject)
  
  if (current_week == "Both") {
    subject_sleep_expand <- filter(CorsanoAnalysisSleepexpand, Subject == current_subject)
    subject_split <- filter(CorsanoAnalysissplit_reclassified, Subject == current_subject)
  } else {
    subject_sleep_expand <- filter(CorsanoAnalysisSleepexpand, Subject == current_subject, Week == current_week)
    subject_split <- filter(CorsanoAnalysissplit_reclassified, Subject == current_subject, Week == current_week)
  }
  
  process_all_metrics(subject_sleep_expand, subject_split, subject_wave, current_week)
})

SLEEP <- bind_rows(all_subject_results) %>%
  rename(week = Week)


#**================================================================**
#** Part 3: Final Join and Export                                  **
#**================================================================**

# --- Attach all calculated stats together ---
StatSS <- Stat %>%
  full_join(SLEEP, by = c("Patient", "week")) %>%
  select(-any_of("NOCODE")) %>%
  # NEW: Add the MPC (MP Converted) column for easier interpretation
  mutate(MPC = if_else(!is.na(MP) & MP < 0, MP + 24, MP))


# --- Export the Final Data ---
export_path <- file.path(valid_path, "Stats", "Full_Statistics_Sleep_Combined.xlsx")
export_path_2 <- file.path(valid_path, "Outputs","CorsanoAnalysisWave.xlsx")
write.xlsx(StatSS, export_path, rowNames = FALSE, firstRow = TRUE)
write.xlsx(CorsanoAnalysisWave, export_path_2, rowNames=FALSE, firstRow = TRUE)

cat("Analysis complete. Data exported to:", export_path, "\n")

# --- Final Clean Up ---
rm(list = setdiff(ls(), CoreDatasets))
```

```{r}
# NEW LOGIC: Correctly identifies sleep sessions based on an 8-hour gap in "Bed" time.
in_bed_blocks <- CorsanoAnalysisSleepexpand_base %>%
  filter(Bed == 1) %>%
  group_by(Subject) %>%
  mutate(block_id = cumsum(c(0, diff(Time)) > 1/60 + 0.001)) %>%
  group_by(Subject, block_id) %>%
  summarise(start_time = min(Time), end_time = max(Time), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  group_by(Subject) %>%
  mutate(gap_from_prev = start_time - lag(end_time, default = first(start_time) - 9)) %>%
  mutate(SleepSession = cumsum(gap_from_prev > 8)) %>%
  select(Subject, start_time, end_time, SleepSession)

# Map the correct SleepSession ID back to the main dataframe
CorsanoAnalysisSleepexpand <- CorsanoAnalysisSleepexpand_base %>%
  left_join(in_bed_blocks, by = "Subject") %>%
  filter(Time >= start_time & Time <= end_time) %>%
  group_by(Subject, SleepSession) %>%
  do(identify_consolidated_sleep(.)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    Sleep = if_else(in_sleep_period, SleepSession, 0),
    SleepStages = if_else(is.na(SleepStages), 4, SleepStages)
  ) %>%
  select(any_of(colnames(CorsanoAnalysisSleepexpand_base)), Sleep)


#**================================================================**
#** Part 2: Advanced Chronotype & Sleep Quality Analysis           **
#**================================================================**

#=============== Helper Functions ===============#
# --- CRITICAL: Load pracma for findpeaks ---
if (!require("pracma")) {
  warning("The 'pracma' package is not installed. Trying to install it now...")
  install.packages("pracma")
  library(pracma)
} else {
  library(pracma)
}

find_peak_phase <- function(data, column) {
  # Safety check if column exists
  if (!column %in% names(data)) return(NA)
  if (nrow(data) < 5) return(NA) # Not enough data points to find a peak
  
  # Handle errors in findpeaks explicitly and PRINT the error if it occurs
  peaks <- tryCatch({
    findpeaks(data[[column]], minpeakheight = -Inf, minpeakdistance = 1, threshold = 0)
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("Error in find_peak_phase for column", column, ":", e$message, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  })
  
  if (is.null(peaks)) return(NA)
  highest_peak_index <- peaks[which.max(peaks[, 1]), 2]
  return(data$Time[highest_peak_index])
}

safe_which_min_time <- function(time_col, value_col) {
  valid_indices <- !is.na(value_col)
  if (!any(valid_indices)) return(NA_real_)
  return(time_col[valid_indices][which.min(value_col[valid_indices])])
}

safe_which_max_time <- function(time_col, value_col) {
  valid_indices <- !is.na(value_col)
  if (!any(valid_indices)) return(NA_real_)
  return(time_col[valid_indices][which.max(value_col[valid_indices])])
}

#=============== Main Analysis Function ===============#
process_all_metrics <- function(subject_sleep_expand, subject_split, subject_wave, week_type) {
  if (nrow(subject_sleep_expand) == 0) return(NULL)
   
  subjectid <- unique(subject_sleep_expand$Subject)
  Test1 <- subject_split
  
  # --- CRITICAL FIX: Filter Wave Data by Week ---
  # Previously, this only filtered by Time, causing duplicates (Weekday + Weekend rows together)
  # which messed up the cosine curves for findpeaks.
  if ("Week" %in% names(subject_wave)) {
    Test2 <- subject_wave %>% filter(Week == week_type, Time <= 24)
  } else {
    Test2 <- subject_wave %>% filter(Time <= 24)
  }
  
  # Debug print if Test2 is empty (helps identify if Week names mismatch)
  if (nrow(Test2) == 0) {
    cat("Warning: No wave data found for Subject", subjectid, "Week:", week_type, "\n")
  }

  #--- NEW MP & medianSL Calculation ---
  sleep_periods_info <- subject_sleep_expand %>%
    filter(Bed == 1) %>%
    group_by(Subject) %>%
    mutate(time_gap = c(0, diff(Time))) %>%
    mutate(period_id = cumsum(time_gap > 1/60 + 0.001)) %>%
    group_by(Subject, period_id) %>%
    summarise(start_time = min(Time), end_time = max(Time), .groups = 'drop') %>%
    group_by(Subject) %>%
    mutate(gap_from_prev = start_time - lag(end_time, default = first(start_time) - 9)) %>%
    mutate(unique_sleep_period_id = cumsum(gap_from_prev > 8)) %>%
    mutate(duration_hours = end_time - start_time) %>%
    filter(duration_hours >= 3 & duration_hours <= 12)

  if(nrow(sleep_periods_info) > 0) {
    period_metrics <- sleep_periods_info %>%
      mutate(data = map2(start_time, end_time, ~subject_sleep_expand %>% filter(Time >= .x, Time <= .y))) %>%
      mutate(
        Bed_start_time = start_time,
        Sleep_start_time = map_dbl(data, function(period_data) {
          sleep_onset_data <- period_data %>%
            filter(SleepStages %in% c(1, 2, 3) & lag(SleepStages, default = 4) == 4)
          if (nrow(sleep_onset_data) > 0) first(sleep_onset_data$Time) else NA_real_
        }),
        End_time = end_time,
        sleep_latency_minutes = if_else(!is.na(Sleep_start_time), (Sleep_start_time - Bed_start_time) * 60, NA_real_),
        adjusted_end_time = if_else(End_time < Sleep_start_time, End_time + 24, End_time),
        mp_continuous = if_else(!is.na(Sleep_start_time), (Sleep_start_time + adjusted_end_time) / 2, NA_real_),
        mp_24h = mp_continuous %% 24,
        mp_centered = if_else(mp_24h > 12, mp_24h - 24, mp_24h)
      )
    
    final_MP <- mean(period_metrics$mp_centered, na.rm = TRUE)
    valid_latencies <- period_metrics %>% filter(sleep_latency_minutes <= 60)
    final_medianSL <- median(valid_latencies$sleep_latency_minutes, na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    final_MP <- NA_real_
    final_medianSL <- NA_real_
  }

  #--- Other Core Sleep Metrics ---#
  sleep_time_epochs <- sum(subject_sleep_expand$Sleep != 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  bed_time_epochs <- sum(subject_sleep_expand$Bed == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  SE <- if (bed_time_epochs > 0) (sleep_time_epochs / bed_time_epochs) * 100 else 0
  total_sleep_hours <- sleep_time_epochs / 60
  sleep_lagged <- subject_sleep_expand %>% mutate(prev_stage = lag(SleepStages))
  trans1 <- sleep_lagged %>% filter((prev_stage %in% c(1, 3)) & (SleepStages %in% c(2, 4))) %>% nrow()
  FI1 <- if (total_sleep_hours > 0) trans1 / total_sleep_hours else 0
  trans2 <- sleep_lagged %>% filter(!is.na(prev_stage) & prev_stage != SleepStages) %>% nrow()
  FI2 <- if (total_sleep_hours > 0) trans2 / total_sleep_hours else 0
   
  #--- Chronotype: Physiological Nadirs ---#
  min_values <- cbind(
    summarise(Test1, minCBT=safe_which_min_time(Time,CBT), maxSBT=safe_which_max_time(Time,SBT), minHR=safe_which_min_time(Time,HR), minCor=safe_which_min_time(Time,Cortisol)),
    summarise(Test2, minBreath=safe_which_min_time(Time,BreathCosine), minHRV=safe_which_min_time(Time,HRVCosine))
  ) %>% mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(!is.na(.) & . > 12, . - 24, .)))
  all_mins <- unlist(min_values)
  midrange <- mean(c(median(all_mins, na.rm=TRUE), mean(all_mins, na.rm=TRUE)), na.rm=TRUE)
  MAD <- mean(abs(all_mins - midrange), na.rm = TRUE) * 60
  weights <- c(0.25, 0.2, 0.15, 0.2, 0.1, 0.1)
  WMAD <- sum(abs(all_mins - midrange) * weights, na.rm = TRUE) / 6 * 60
   
  #--- Chronotype: Lark vs. Owl ---#
  mid <- ifelse(!is.na(midrange) & midrange > 14, midrange - 24, midrange)
  Lark <- pmax(0, pmin(100, (-(mid - 2) / 8 + 0.5) * 100))
   
  #--- Chronotype: Energy/Activity Peak ---#
  # Safety Check: Ensure Test2 has data before running findpeaks
  if (nrow(Test2) > 10) {
    PA <- find_peak_phase(Test2, "StepsCosine")
    TA_cos <- find_peak_phase(Test2 %>% mutate(StepsCosine = -StepsCosine), "StepsCosine")
    AEarly <- if (!is.na(PA) && !is.na(TA_cos)) pmax(0, pmin(100, (-(PA - (TA_cos+12)) / 8 + 0.5) * 100)) else NA
  } else {
    AEarly <- NA
  }

  #--- Rapid vs. Sluggish Wake Up ---#
  metrics <- c("CBTCosine", "HRCosine", "BreathCosine", "HRVCosine", "CortisolCosine", "StressCosine", "-SBTCosine", "-RRCosine")
  
  if (nrow(Test2) > 10) {
    results_list <- lapply(metrics, function(metric) {
      metric_name <- sub("-", "", metric)
      
      # Check if column exists
      if(!metric_name %in% names(Test2)) return(NULL)
      
      y <- if(startsWith(metric,"-")) -Test2[[metric_name]] else Test2[[metric_name]]
      if(all(is.na(y))) return(NULL)
      
      x <- Test2$Time
      y_doubled <- c(y, y); x_doubled <- c(x, x + 24); min_index <- which.min(y)
      
      peaks <- tryCatch({
        findpeaks(y_doubled[min_index:(min_index + length(y))])
      }, error = function(e) {
        cat("Error in Rapid/Sluggish findpeaks:", e$message, "\n")
        return(NULL)
      })
      if(is.null(peaks)) return(NULL)
      
      peak_index <- min_index + peaks[1, 2] - 1
      if (length(peak_index) == 0 || peak_index == min_index) return(NULL)
      
      slope_upward <- (y_doubled[peak_index] - y_doubled[min_index]) / (x_doubled[peak_index] - x_doubled[min_index])
      highest_peak_index <- which.max(y)
      
      troughs <- tryCatch({
        findpeaks(-y_doubled[highest_peak_index:(highest_peak_index + length(y))])
      }, error = function(e) { return(NULL) })
      if(is.null(troughs)) return(NULL)
      
      next_min_index <- highest_peak_index + troughs[1, 2] - 1
      if(length(next_min_index) == 0 || next_min_index == highest_peak_index) return(NULL)
      
      slope_downward <- -(y_doubled[next_min_index] - y_doubled[highest_peak_index]) / (x_doubled[next_min_index] - x_doubled[highest_peak_index])
      amplitude <- (max(y, na.rm=T) - min(y, na.rm=T)) / 2; mid_slope <- (max(y, na.rm=T) - min(y, na.rm=T)) / 12
      
      if(amplitude == 0) return(NULL)
      
      AAARapid <- pmax(0, pmin(100, (((slope_upward - mid_slope) / amplitude / 2 * 10) + 0.5) * 100))
      ABAFast <- pmax(0, pmin(100, (((slope_downward - mid_slope) / amplitude / 2 * 10) + 0.5) * 100))
      
      return(data.frame(AAARapid, ABAFast))
    })
    
    wake_sleep_metrics <- do.call(rbind, results_list)
  } else {
    wake_sleep_metrics <- NULL
  }
  
  # === FIX FOR MEAN ===
  if (!is.null(wake_sleep_metrics) && nrow(wake_sleep_metrics) > 0) {
    AAARapid_avg <- mean(wake_sleep_metrics$AAARapid, na.rm = TRUE)
    ABAFast_avg <- mean(wake_sleep_metrics$ABAFast, na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    AAARapid_avg <- NA_real_
    ABAFast_avg <- NA_real_
  }

  #--- Combine All Results ---#
  midrangeC <- if_else(!is.na(midrange) & midrange < 0, midrange + 24, midrange)
   
  return(data.frame(
    Patient = subjectid, Week = week_type, medianSL = final_medianSL, SE = SE, FI1 = FI1, FI2 = FI2, MP = final_MP,
    midrange = midrange, midrangeC = midrangeC, WMAD = WMAD, MAD = MAD, L = Lark, O = 100 - Lark, E = AEarly, D = 100 - AEarly,
    R = AAARapid_avg, S = 100 - AAARapid_avg, F = ABAFast_avg, I = 100 - ABAFast_avg
  ))
}

#=============== Execute the Analysis Loop ===============#

# --- Reclassify Week for Consistency ---
CorsanoAnalysissplit_reclassified <- CorsanoAnalysissplit %>%
  mutate(
    Time24 = Time %% 24,
    Week = case_when(
      Day == "Friday" & Time24 >= 18 ~ "Weekend",
      Day == "Sunday" & Time24 >= 18 ~ "Weekday",
      Day %in% c("Saturday", "Sunday") ~ "Weekend",
      TRUE ~ "Weekday"
    )
  ) %>% select(-Time24)

# --- Create Task List ---
analysis_groups <- bind_rows(
  distinct(CorsanoAnalysissplit_reclassified, Subject, Week) %>% filter(!is.na(Week)),
  distinct(CorsanoAnalysissplit_reclassified, Subject) %>% mutate(Week = "Both")
)

# --- Run Analysis Loop ---
all_subject_results <- lapply(1:nrow(analysis_groups), function(i) {
  current_subject <- analysis_groups$Subject[i]
  current_week <- analysis_groups$Week[i]
  cat("Processing Patient:", current_subject, "for Week:", current_week, "\n")
  
  subject_wave <- filter(CorsanoAnalysisWave, Subject == current_subject)
  
  if (current_week == "Both") {
    subject_sleep_expand <- filter(CorsanoAnalysisSleepexpand, Subject == current_subject)
    subject_split <- filter(CorsanoAnalysissplit_reclassified, Subject == current_subject)
  } else {
    subject_sleep_expand <- filter(CorsanoAnalysisSleepexpand, Subject == current_subject, Week == current_week)
    subject_split <- filter(CorsanoAnalysissplit_reclassified, Subject == current_subject, Week == current_week)
  }
  
  process_all_metrics(subject_sleep_expand, subject_split, subject_wave, current_week)
})

SLEEP <- bind_rows(all_subject_results) %>%
  rename(week = Week)


#**================================================================**
#** Part 3: Final Join and Export                                  **
#**================================================================**

# --- Attach all calculated stats together ---
StatSS <- Stat %>%
  full_join(SLEEP, by = c("Patient", "week")) %>%
  select(-any_of("NOCODE")) %>%
  # NEW: Add the MPC (MP Converted) column for easier interpretation
  mutate(MPC = if_else(!is.na(MP) & MP < 0, MP + 24, MP))


# --- Export the Final Data ---
export_path <- file.path(valid_path, "Stats", "Full_Statistics_Sleep_Combined.xlsx")
export_path_2 <- file.path(valid_path, "Outputs","CorsanoAnalysisWave.xlsx")
write.xlsx(StatSS, export_path, rowNames = FALSE, firstRow = TRUE)
write.xlsx(CorsanoAnalysisWave, export_path_2, rowNames=FALSE, firstRow = TRUE)

cat("Analysis complete. Data exported to:", export_path, "\n")

# --- Final Clean Up ---
rm(list = setdiff(ls(), CoreDatasets))
```
